compilerPreview: Every history compiler_preview.detail.compiler must equal top compiler exactly. Difference yields CREATION_PROVIDER_DECLARATION_UNSUPPORTED after trusted binding.
mixedCore: Preflight permits known legacy package/version keys (even if replacing new keys) through to binding; after binding any such mixed new core yields CREATION_EVIDENCE_FORMAT_AMBIGUOUS. Other unknown new core/compiler keys remain MALFORMED.
canonicalDepth: Root depth 0; every visited value including root and containers counts; object keys are Unicode-checked but are not additional values.
